cms.support: Open-source software maintained by the WordPress community.
cms.technology: PHP, MySQL or MariaDB, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
cms.capabilities: Supports themes, plugins, custom templates, APIs, blogging, and e-commerce.
cms.limitations: Requires regular updates. Poorly maintained plugins can create security risks.

cms.support: Open-source software maintained by the Drupal community.
cms.technology: PHP, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
cms.capabilities: Supports themes, modules, custom content types, user permissions, and APIs.
cms.limitations: Can be difficult for beginners. Advanced customization may require programming experience.

cms.support: Open-source software maintained by the Joomla community.
cms.technology: PHP, MySQL or MariaDB, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
cms.capabilities: Supports templates, extensions, multilingual websites, user management, and content organization.
cms.limitations: Has a learning curve, and some advanced extensions require payment.

cms.support: Commercial hosted platform supported by Shopify.
cms.technology: Cloud hosting, Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify-managed databases.
cms.capabilities: Supports themes, apps, product management, payment processing, inventory, and online stores.
cms.limitations: Requires a paid subscription. Some advanced features and apps cost extra.

cms.support: Open-source publishing platform developed by Ghost Foundation, with paid hosting available through Ghost(Pro).
cms.technology: Node.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and MySQL.
cms.capabilities: Supports themes, memberships, subscriptions, newsletters, publishing, and APIs.
cms.limitations: Primarily designed for publishing. Some advanced customization requires programming knowledge.
